exports.name: decode_escape
exports.signature: pub fn decode_escape(input: &[u8], backslash_offset: u32) -> Result<DecodedEscape>
exports.behavior: Decodes simple escapes, hexadecimal BMP scalars, and adjacent UTF-16 surrogate pairs. Preserves absolute error offsets and rejects invalid spellings without replacement.

exports.name: unescape
exports.signature: pub fn unescape(input: &[u8], content: Span32, sink: &mut dyn ByteSink) -> Result<StringLengths>
exports.behavior: Checks the span, validates and measures complete content before any sink call, reserves the exact decoded byte length, then emits original UTF-8 runs and decoded scalars. Lookahead ends at the content boundary. Sink errors propagate unchanged.

coverage: All eight simple escape spellings and all invalid escape-letter byte values
All 65536 BMP code units, rejecting all surrogate code units when isolated
Mixed uppercase and lowercase hex, embedded NUL, UTF-8 width boundaries, U+10000, U+10FFFF, and emoji
Every high surrogate with both low-surrogate boundaries and every low surrogate with both high-surrogate boundaries
Every truncated surrogate-pair boundary, absent or partial second prefixes, and wrong second-unit ranges
Invalid hex at every digit position in either code unit, including invalid digits before a truncated suffix
Nonzero absolute offsets, out-of-range offsets, checked span overflow, out-of-bounds spans, and empty spans
Raw UTF-8 preservation without normalization and mixed raw content with all simple escape outputs
Raw run lengths zero through 128 at starting offsets zero through 16 with an escaped Euro sign at the tail
Wave 1 scan span integration and strict rejection of escape spellings accepted by discovery
All 32 raw control bytes, raw quotes, malformed UTF-8, UTF-8 surrogate encodings, overlong encodings, and values beyond U+10FFFF
Bounded lookahead with completing bytes outside content and absolute EOF rebasing
Source-order error precedence after valid decoded prefixes and no sink calls on invalid input
Exact reservation and appended counts with prior sink data, reservation failure, write failures, and unchanged error metadata
Synthetic u32 byte and scalar counter boundaries with atomic counter updates and source-position overflow errors
